scope: Einleitung 01 and level chooser material, transparent bounds and typography review

sources.savedComparisonStatus: Historical v2 only; superseded for current component decisions by 01-v4.png and level-v4.png

a2v3.improvement: Bronze center is darker and separates better from the raised gold glyph faces.
remainingFailures: A right foot and 2 lower stroke still visually join at the baseline.
Broad and very bright outer rim remains more prominent than the lettering at a 56 px visible coin diameter.
White highlight covers too much of the annulus instead of reading as a localized specular edge.

proposedAcceptanceThresholds.status: Designer proposed criteria, not measured exact source pixel values
proposedAcceptanceThresholds.highlightExtent: Localized upper-left arc; the surrounding rim remains satin antique gold rather than a white ring.
proposedAcceptanceThresholds.glyphDepth: Pale gold face, narrow upper-left bevel, short dark lower-right extrusion; no merging bevels or cast shadows.
proposedAcceptanceThresholds.centering: Center the full A2 inscription optically after separating the glyphs.

a2v3.nextEditPrompt: Keep this exact coin silhouette, transparent background and dark bronze face. Separate A and 2 into two clearly independent embossed serif glyphs: shorten A's right foot and shift the glyphs apart so the narrowest dark-bronze gap is 2 to 2.5 pixels when the visible coin is 56 pixels wide, about 37 to 46 source pixels for its 1042-pixel visible body. Keep the full inscription centered; never join the glyph bevels or shadows. Reduce the broad outer rim brightness and make it satin antique gold. Limit the near-white specular edge to 0.75 to 1 display pixel; the brightest reflection occupies only a short upper-left arc, not a white ring. Retain a slim gold inner edge and dark engraved groove. Do not enlarge the lettering or add rings, marks or ornaments.

transparentBounds.method: Pillow alpha >= 128 bbox, right and bottom exclusive; no images written or edited
transparentBounds.warning: Do not size by alpha > 0 bbox: extremely faint stray pixels and shadow tails enlarge those bounds.

levelTypography.issue: Current standard Noto Serif Bold is wider than the original level labels at similar cap height.
levelTypography.inventoryMethod: Read-only figma.listAvailableFontsAsync; no text or canvas nodes modified

localFontMeasurement.method: Pillow getmask ink bbox, local FreeType raster, size 34, weight 700; this is candidate metric evidence rather than Figma rendered parity

reReviewConditions: Export all six labels at the same 402 x 934 viewport and 100% text scale.
Compare actual ink width, cap height, A apex and serifs, 1 top flag/base, 2 upper curve/base, B bowls and C aperture.
Keep normal tracking initially; do not force narrow width with negative letter spacing or reduce cap height.
Treat ExtraCondensed Bold as a closer editable candidate, not as a confirmed original font.

selectedLevelBorder.correction: A single coherent compound rim: deep jade outer edge, fine gold inner edge, restrained lower contact shadow. Avoid duplicate nested decorative frames.
selectedLevelBorder.currentV4Evidence: At x=300, top jade y=575..578, gold y=579, bottom gold y=634, jade y=635..638, contact shadow y=639..641. Jade RGB 0,84,73; gold approximately 223,190,122.

currentComponentReviewV4.reviewScope: Only A2 medallion, supplied check, selected A2 card compound border, and six large level labels. No whole-screen or app approval.

a2Medallion.evidence: At the actual 56 px display size A and 2 read independently. A dark interval now separates their lower serifs and bevels. The broad white annulus has become restrained satin gold; dark bronze face and pale raised letters remain distinct.
a2Medallion.scopeLimit: Material and small-scale legibility pass; no claim of original pixel identity.

suppliedCheck.evidence: The 34 px visible circle and pale check are clearly readable, seated within the selected card without clipping or overlap. Padding shrinkage is resolved in the actual export.

selectedLevelBorder.evidence: Actual export contains a coherent 4 px jade outer edge, approximately 1 px gold inner edge and restrained lower contact shadow. The check and label are separated from the rim.

largeLevelLabels.reason: Direct normalized original measurement supersedes the earlier approximate 35 x 25 target. Original labels ending in 2 are about 4 px wider than labels ending in 1. Current ExtraCondensed labels have nearly equal widths and make A2, B2 and especially C1/C2 too narrow.
largeLevelLabels.measurementMethod: Original phone app rectangle (52,52,748,1738) normalized to 402 x 934 with Lanczos only in memory; find dark ink using max(R,G,B)<105 within each label region. No source images or crops were saved as assets.
largeLevelLabels.fontFeatureInvestigation: Bundled Noto Serif exposes pnum, but fontTools outline measurements show pnum does not produce the original approximately 4 px ink-width difference between terminal 1 and 2. Do not assume enabling pnum solves the mismatch.
largeLevelLabels.remainingCorrection: Select or tune the level serif against all six original labels, preserving cap height and the narrower numeral 1. Do not reduce every label to the A1 width target. Glyph shape and width require one fresh rendered re-review.
largeLevelLabels.geometryOutsideScope: Current C-row ink begins about 3 px below reference. Root is reviewing geometry separately.

approvalConditions: Review latest actual 01 and level chooser exports rather than unchanged v2 evidence.
A2 must be legible at visible 56 px with a clean dark gap and restrained rim highlights.
Supplied check must occupy visible 34 px and remain centered without alpha-padding shrinkage.
Selected border, labels and check must not overlap, double-outline or clip.
No source screenshot pixels may become runtime assets.
Static artwork, Figma interaction, Flutter integration and device validation remain separate claims.

fontCandidateInvestigation.method: Read official Google Fonts TTF bytes into memory, render with Pillow at weights 600/700, available width and optical axes, sizes29..43; compare six dark ink bounding boxes and ink counts against normalized source. No font/image files written.

finalRecommendation.why: Among 13 measured serif families, Lora Bold35 preserves a source-like sturdy bracketed serif and naturally narrower1. Noto Serif Display approximates dimensions but its very thin hairlines fail the original visual character. Plain Noto Serif does not reproduce the numeral ink-width difference. Lora was visually compared to all six source labels in an in-memory 3x nearest-neighbor diagnostic.
finalRecommendation.remainingVariance: A widths and height match; B is1px wider; C is2px wider and1px shorter in the local thresholded raster. These are candidate tolerances to inspect in Figma, not a source identity or 100% parity claim.
finalRecommendation.proposedNodeRectStatus: Precise starting rectangles derived from source optical centers and Lora metrics; not yet Figma-render verified. If root moves card geometry, preserve the source ink targets rather than copying old parent-relative offsets.

badgeFamilyReview.fitPolicy: Uniform scale by alpha128 body width; never distort to force 56x56. Render full image including low-alpha shadow with this scale and offset.

review.visualMethod: Original RGBA masters uniformly downsampled with Lanczos into transient in-memory inspection panels; actual 56 px body and 3x nearest-neighbor diagnostic enlargement viewed. No assets created, modified or cropped on disk.
review.judgment: All seven preserve the accepted A2v4 dark bronze face, pale raised gold relief, restrained satin rim and upper-left light. Lower/right glyph shadows support relief. No broad white ring. Alpha body widths normalized to 56 while preserving original aspect ratio.

criteria.legibility: Each A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2 pair is readable at 56 px; the numeral 1 remains visibly narrower than 2; a dark channel separates each glyph pair without touching serif bevels.
criteria.seedling: Two leaves and central stem remain recognizable at 56 px. It reads as a beginner symbol with the same relief height and metal palette.
criteria.familyConsistency: Visible body height ranges 54.98–55.36 px at width56; this small natural oblate variation is acceptable and should not be stretched into a forced circle.
criteria.rim: Bright upper-left bevel is bounded; dark inner channel and lower bronze edge remain visible. Do not brighten the entire circumference.
criteria.padding: Use alpha>=128 body geometry for scale/offset; retain the full image including low-alpha contact shadow. Alpha>0 bounds would shrink the visible medal.

newGoldCandidate.thresholdCaveat: High-alpha masks show edge sensitivity; alpha255 is not a face segmentation because many gold face pixels have alpha253. Keep alpha128 for placement.
newGoldCandidate.actualSizeJudgment: At370px width the visible metallic face, round corners and lower bronze/contact edge have source-like slim proportions. The1.154px excess in alpha128 bounds is acceptable within raster-source edge uncertainty and does not justify another generation. Full source corners and lower contact edge are retained.
newGoldCandidate.materialLimit: New lower contact edge is slightly darker/more continuous than the source; verify it remains a thin grounding edge over the actual footer.

newJadeCandidate.judgment: Organic cloudy jade removes the prior fine woven swirl. Full header composition is required to judge brightness and contrast around title/brand/tiger. Do not retain the old402x603 node with square FIT because it would add vertical free space.

patchMetricsAt402Square.interpretation: New texture has a brighter cloud at this location; random texture phase means this is not an exact color-equivalence metric. Two other open source patches are much closer in green/blue. Avoid speculative global darkening before composed review.

goldCta.judgment: Actual370px whole-image placement restores the slim source-like gold body. All rounded corners remain visible, the lower contact lip is thin and the label is legible. The52.154px alpha128 outer height is accepted under the explicit51+/-1.5px review tolerance.

mainRightArrow.judgment: Closed dark10x16 vector has a restrained gold bevel and clear rightward direction. The old thin text glyph no longer appears.

selectedLevelField.judgment: Jade rail, fine gold bevel and lower contact edge give the field coherent depth without duplicated heavy outlines or label collisions.

changeAction.judgment: Jade face has upper-to-lower lighting, a fine metallic edge and visible gold down-chevron. Label and arrow have distinct space within the48px hit frame.
